name: eventflow
description: EventFlow - serverless event registration platform (React + Cloudscape + API Gateway + Lambda + DynamoDB + Cognito, deployed with AWS CDK)

scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w infra
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w infra
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w infra
